observations.behavior: Adds three new error message constants and a dictionary entry, and a conditional check in credential validation.
observations.code_quote: _SSH_GATEWAY_SESSION_ERROR = "Could not establish session to SSH gateway"
observations.posthog_connection: These constants are used to normalize and translate raw SSH tunnel errors into user-friendly messages, replacing the raw error string with a standardized message. This could help users understand connection failures without exposing internal implementation details or raw error messages.

observations.behavior: Replaces a raw error string with a standardized error message in the credential validation, and adds a dictionary entry for the same replacement.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could help PostHog users receive consistent, user-friendly error messages when their ClickHouse warehouse connection fails due to SSH gateway issues, rather than raw, potentially confusing error messages.
